review: Read full 1805-line setup inbox, 1659-line test suite, Agent Access page and unchanged navigation/room-guide helpers. Previously reviewed durable pairing/helper/control modules are hash-checked against the staged source index. First-party UI and explicit synthetic fixtures only.

Owner list reads parse a strict request shape and use a generation guard. Slow automatic owner reads finish before the next poll; unavailable/unauthorized reads hide the inbox, transient failures suspend approval. Request and review IDs key the dialog, and resident UI is keyed by request.

Pairing checks exact account, installation, client/task/chat identity, current contract revision, finite expiry and registered destination. It reconciles existing or uncertain invitation issuance before considering another. Client-declared task identity is disclosed and server validation remains separate.

Discord selection freshly rechecks the approved source snapshot before mutations. Resume hints are not authority; revoked/expired requests do not replay them. Selection setup does not itself publish transcript text. Responses budget activation remains a distinct approved scope and calls native enforcement without performing inference.

Room membership, room-service OAuth, native grants, source staging, current player/connector facts, voice consent, game authority and provider budget remain distinct UI states. Source/preparation/mission controls are explicit owner actions; tests use mocked endpoints and do not qualify native enforcement.

Agent Access now renders the setup inbox alongside its existing guide and connection controls. AgentConnectionSetup has separate unreviewed canonical changes and remains at the older public bytes; this source preview is intentionally incomplete and not a runnable app.

Normalized eight groups of older fixture identities/labels: named world, three room UUIDs and four Discord snowflakes now use explicit fixture values. All expectations refer to the same replacements; no production changes.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal only; no publication, account approval, native restart or actual pairing/Discord/game operation.
Mocked inbox tests verify selected UI and request orchestration, not a live ordinary-account deployment, signed continuation, native authority or model funding.
Shared setup contracts/projections and domain/native endpoints remain separate held dependencies. AgentConnectionSetup and account portal changes still require source review.

Per-service poll behavior under long native/network latency, cross-account outstanding continuations and full installed action/revocation behavior remain acceptance concerns; no broad live claim is made.
